item.title: Heritage minister says hockey romance 'Heated Rivalry' is a Cancon triumph
item.description: OTTAWA — The Canadian TV show "Heated Rivalry" is winning fans all around the world — including Culture Minister Marc Miller, who calls the show a Cancon triumph.

item.title: Ontario proposes to pause rule that lets cities require affordable housing units
item.description: TORONTO — Ontario is proposing to temporarily ban three major cities from requiring a certain percentage of affordable units in new buildings near transit stations, citing a downturn in the housing market.

item.title: A South Korean court sentences Yoon to 5 years in prison on charges related to martial law decree
item.description: SEOUL, South Korea (AP) — A South Korean court sentenced former President Yoon Suk Yeol to five years in prison Friday on some charges related to his imposition of martial law.

item.title: Canada's Mboko advances to Adelaide International women's tennis final
item.description: ADELAIDE — Canada's Victoria Mboko is onto the Adelaide International women's tennis final. The 19-year-old from Toronto defeated Australia's Kimberly Birrell 6-2, 6-1 in the semifinals on Thursday to advance.

item.title: Thompson's hat trick powers Sabres past Canadiens 5-3
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (AP) — Tage Thompson scored three times, including the 200th of his career, and added two assists in the Buffalo Sabres’ 5-3 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Thursday night.
